reviews.rationale: Independently inspected source-profile transport correspondences. Profile-specific decisions distinguish native conditional EURO-class mixtures from whole-service geographic proxies. The existing older physical mappings are carried forward separately. Positive unit references do not establish numerical or functional-performance equivalence.
limitations: Only the exact inspected source ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off context gains a new approval for UVEK 2025/native 2026 cut-off with ecoinvent 3.10 biosphere. No patch, inverse or consequential route is inferred. Prior approved physical targets, factors and existing recipe contents are preserved.

Source and native services have positive one-unit references. Factor +1 preserves signed caller quantities, supported uncertainty and formulas, foreground ownership and separate emissions. Freight remains tkm and car transport remains vehicle-km. Do not rescale payload, gross vehicle weight, distance, occupancy, fuel consumption, efficiency or lifetime.

Use complete native services with their upstream fuel, vehicle/infrastructure, operation, maintenance, releases and end-of-life inputs once. Do not add those source service inputs or credits on top.
